summary: 311 items collected in the past 30 days, 10 picks (Leading agents 8, Model releases 2). Headline: Release v0.28.3.

items.title: Release v0.28.3
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code ships v0.28.3, hardening end-to-end verification for scheduled loop tasks and the state guards in PR checks, along with container and VM refinements.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Agent and release · Published within 24 hours

items.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.en_title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.en_oneliner: Google has added Tool Retrieval to the Gemini API in preview, letting agents keep a large tool library on standby and load parameter schemas only when needed, cutting input tokens while keeping tool selection accurate.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Gemini and Tools

items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.en_title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.en_oneliner: Financial research platform Hebbia found GPT-6 Astra ahead of rival models on both citation accuracy and presentation quality: it scored 13.6 points above the best alternative on citing required sources, 99.5% of its citations were relevant to the question, and its decks met 97.9% of formatting requirements.
items.reason: Official source · Covers GPT and release

items.title: v4.1.27
items.en_oneliner: Cline ships v4.1.27 with a major model catalog refresh — 94 new providers and new defaults such as Kimi K3.1 Pro — plus LM Studio auth, MCP read-only badges, and fuller file reads.
items.reason: Covers Tools and API · Published within 24 hours

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon in GitHub Copilot
items.en_oneliner: GitHub Copilot now offers Google's latest Gemini 4 Neon for agentic coding, multistep tool calls and knowledge tasks.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Gemini and Agent

items.en_oneliner: Version 2.1.329 adds two safety prompts for hook configuration: the dialog now shows which folder a hook is declared in, and non-interactive hosts also flag hooks from managed settings.

items.title: Introducing Kiro for VS Code
items.en_oneliner: Kiro has landed in VS Code for macOS, Windows, and Linux, letting developers use the Kiro agent without leaving the editor.
Claude Code 2.1.330 adds enterprise admin console sign-in, a built-in chart-drawing mod called easel, and several self-hosted runner and plugin install improvements.

items.title: SDK v0.2.1
items.en_oneliner: Cline SDK v0.2.1 stops trimming file-read results to the 8k cap and passes them through at the 50k file-content limit, so models see the full content.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
items.en_oneliner: ChatGPT Wallet lets agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots complete purchases with user approval while keeping existing card protections.
items.reason: Official source · Covers GPT and Agent
